drawings.description: croquis de la marge gauche : $x'$ se spécialise en $x_1$ et en $x$, $x_1$ en $x$, et $y'$ en $y$ ; à côté, au crayon : $T = \overline{\{x'\}}$, $(T_y \cap U) \cup (T_y \cap Z) \subset \uncertain{T_y}$
drawings.notes: Margin sketch, nodes placed once and every arrow drawn on the line between the same two node points: U_y ni x_1 above X_y ni x, x' to the right with arrows to x_1 and to x, the arrow x_1 -> x; below, the dots y and y' (labels under them) with the arrow y' -> y. Above, in pencil, T = closure{x'} and (T_y cap U) cup (T_y cap Z) subset T_y, written after the transcription (the last T_y is uncertain there; on the page it reads like a T with a curl). Left out: the boxed note and the struck words in the same margin, which belong to other lines of the page, and the word "de" right of the first formula. Still differs: the formulas are set in one line each, the hand is larger and slanted. Redrawn 2026-11-09 (issue 128): to check again. Question settled by a machine pass on the facsimile, 2026-11-12 (maths): the last letter of the pencil formula is T_y: the union of (T_y cap U) and (T_y cap Z) is a subset of T_y, and the curl is the subscript y. Not checked by a reader.

drawings.description: croquis de la marge gauche, entouré d'une accolade avec $G_n$, $U_n$ ; les flèches entre $\hat{x}_1$, $\hat{x}'$ et $\hat{x}$ sont surchargées et ne sont pas reproduites ; un mot biffé suit « $\mathrm{Ass}\, \widehat{U}$ »
drawings.notes: Margin sketch, nodes placed once, every arrow on the line between the same two node points: x_1 <- x', x_1 -> x, x' -> x; X <- X^ = X' supset U'; X - Y (a heavy stroke without a visible head, drawn so); X_n and Y_n with hooked strokes towards X and Y, both ending at the brace (the Y_n one with a heavy end); X_n - Y_n (a short stroke) with f_n beside it; y - y'. Hatted points x^_1, x^' in Ass U^, and x^ below. On the left G_n and U_n, and the long brace (pencil). The overinked arrows between the hatted points are not drawn, as in the transcription; the struck word after Ass U^ and a letter under U_n are left out. Still differs: the transcription has a plain arrow X_n -> X; on the page both X_n and Y_n have hooked strokes (drawn with hooks); G_n reads like G_{U_n} and U_n like U_{nn} on the page (labels after the transcription). Redrawn 2026-11-09 (issue 128): to check again. Question settled by a machine pass on the facsimile, 2026-11-12 (maths): X_n and Y_n are the infinitesimal neighbourhoods, closed subschemes of X and Y, so the hooked strokes (inclusions) drawn here are right and the transcription's plain arrow is not what the page has. Not checked by a reader. Question settled by a machine pass on the facsimile, 2026-11-12 (page): the upper label beside the brace reads G with the subscript U_n (the page's own diagram has i_{n*}(G_{U_n})), now drawn G_{U_n}; the lower one is U_n, its last strokes an overwriting; the transcription's G_n is to be corrected there. Not checked by a reader. Question settled by a machine pass on the facsimile, 2026-11-12 (page): the blot after Ass U^ is a word struck out with a heavy stroke; it stays left out. Not checked by a reader.

drawings.description: croquis, sous « EGA IV 9 » ; points $x_0$, $x'_0$ sur $X'$, $x$, $x'$ sur $X$, $y$, $y'$ sur $Y$, $y_0$, $y'_0$ sous $Y'$ ; à côté un second croquis semblable, où $X'$ et $Y'$ sont reliés à $X$, $Y$ par des traits obliques, avec $Y''$ \uncertain{et} $y''_0$, $y_0$ ; les directions des traits sans flèche ne sont pas marquées
drawings.kind: two sketches of base changes with points
drawings.notes: Left sketch, under "EGA IV 9": X' (with x_0, x'_0 to its left), X (with x, x'), Y' (with y_0, y'_0 below), Y (with y, y'); X' - X, X - Y, Y' - Y; between Y' and X' two strokes, a plain one and an arrow up (Y' -> X'); the arrow Y' -> X. Right sketch, fainter: X' (x_0, x'_0 beside it), X, Y'', Y; X' - X and Y'' - Y oblique, X - Y, X' - Y'' with a faint arrow up beside it, and a dashed oblique from X towards Y''; y''_0, y_0 below. Nodes placed once, every stroke on the line between the same two node points; directions of plain strokes not marked, as in the transcription. Still differs: in the right sketch the labels beside X' are small and overinked (read x_0, x'_0 as in the left sketch) and the x right of X is cut by the crop edge. Redrawn 2026-11-09 (issue 128): to check again. Question settled by a machine pass on the facsimile, 2026-11-12 (page): the two small labels left of X' in the right sketch read x_0 and x'_0 on a 300 dpi crop, as in the left sketch and as drawn. Not checked by a reader.

drawings.description: au bas de la page, des croquis et notes au crayon sans rapport visible avec ce qui précède et qui reprennent les pages 3--4 : $T' \to T$ au-dessus de $X' \to X$ (points $x'$, $x$), $T'_y$ et $T_y$ ; « $U \cap T_y$ dense dans $T_y$ », « $U \cap T'_y$ dense dans $T'_y$ », « $T' = \bigcup T'_i$, $T = \bigcup T_i$ » ; et à l'encre, à droite, des signes $\hat{I}$, $\hat{\eta}$, $\hat{X} \cup \overline{\{x\}}$, dont l'articulation n'est pas lisible
drawings.kind: pencil notes and sketches (bottom of page)
drawings.notes: Bottom of the page. Left column: points x', x; X' -> X; T' - T; T'_y - T_y (nodes placed once, each stroke on the line between the same two node points). The pencil notes written along the sheet ("U cap T_y dense dans T_y", "U cap T'_y dense dans T'_y", "T' = U T'_i", "T = U T_i") as rotated text, after the transcription. On the right, in ink: I^ (a small mark before it left out), I^ with a vertical = under it, then X^ cup {x} with a bar under {x} and a pencil oval round {x}, I^ under the bar, and eta^ to the left; placed as on the page, their articulation not legible, as the transcription says. The long pencil line crossing the right half is drawn faint. Left out: the formulas of the text above, cut by the crop. Still differs: the transcription puts T' -> T above X' -> X; on the page X' -> X is above T' - T, and T' - T has no visible arrowhead (see disagreement); the bar of "X^ cup closure{x}" is under {x} on the page. Redrawn 2026-11-09 (issue 128): to check again. Question settled by a machine pass on the facsimile, 2026-11-12 (page): on the page X' -> X stands above T' -> T (the transcription has the other order), and a small faint arrow head is visible between T' and T; the arrow head is now drawn. Not checked by a reader.
drawings.disagreement: T' -> T is under X' -> X on the page (the transcription says above), and its stroke has no visible arrowhead

drawings.description: page de notes et de croquis au crayon, sans texte suivi ; elles accompagnent le Th.~1.4 (pages 3--4). Les éléments en sont donnés dans l'ordre de la page, sans chercher à les relier
